_comment: PROTECTED. The allocating agent may not edit this file or anything in core/. Only the human operator changes these. Hard ceilings live in core/validate.py, so raising a cap is a protected-core edit by design.
_rpc_comment: The default endpoint: the public Robinhood Chain RPC, so a fork never reads the chain through someone else's gateway. The env var MEL_RPC_URL overrides it. The operator's runs set MEL_RPC_URL to the Olas RPC gateway for Robinhood Chain (the endpoint Pearl configures for Connect services on chain 4663), used since 2026-10-06; the cloud routines get it from their 'Mel' environment. The public endpoint throttled and refused eth_getLogs often enough to void a third of the forecast ledger, so a reliable run needs its own endpoint.
_max_venue_share_comment: No single venue may hold more than this fraction of the bankroll.
_min_hold_comment: An allocation held for less than this is not scored. Shorter holds are dominated by entry cost and teach nothing.
_min_expected_net_comment: An allocation must forecast a net gain above round-trip cost of at least this many basis points, or the agent must leave the capital idle. Doing nothing is always a legal move.
_min_free_liquidity_comment: A Morpho market must hold free liquidity (total supply minus total borrow) of at least this many times the allocation, at entry and at exit. At 100% utilization a withdraw reverts, so a share-price settlement would describe an exit that could not happen. The agent may tighten this in strategy/venue-filters.json, never loosen it.
_loss_mark_comment: A position the venue still cannot pay back this long past its forecast horizon is loss-marked by core/settle.py: booked at what the venue could pay a withdrawer then, usually zero, and scored. Every run re-checks a marked row and settles it over its real hold when the venue pays it back. A day of hourly retries first, four times the forecast ledger's six-hour grace, because a drained vault refills from repayments over days (a00036, a00065).

real._comment: Dormant until the operator enables it. Pearl Connect runs on chain 4663 since 2026-10-06: service #12, service safe below. Enabling real allocation is an operator act.
